# A fill made as of a read races a write to the same file: once the write
# lands, the fill is stale and refused, and the write's bytes stay. A fill as
# of a read after the write brings back only what is absent.
write s=1 f=1 len=32 b=97
offload s=1 f=1
release s=1 f=1
read s=1 f=1 len=32
write s=1 f=1 off=8 len=4 b=120
fill s=1 f=1
read s=1 f=1 len=32
fill s=1 f=1
stalefill s=1 f=1
crash s=1 f=1
